'''SG-1984''' was the designation of a [[Senate Commando/Legends|commando]] who served in the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was part of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|security]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|detail]] that protected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All right. Move along, but stay sharp.|Derrown to SG-1984|<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo" />}}
SG-1984 was stationed in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] along with other members of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] and the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. Their assignment was to ensure the safety of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive]] [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], while he hosted the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Part of the Chancellor's security included a domed [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] that covered the stage during the celebration. While patrolling the staircase that led to the stage, SG-1984 encountered the [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], one of several [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired to abduct Palpatine by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]].<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo" />

With the aid of [[Sinrich/Legends|Sinrich's]] [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic technology]], Derrown disguised himself as a [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]. SG-1984 was deceived by the bounty hunter's facade, and thus failed to prevent him from deactivating the ray shield. The plot failed due to the efforts of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[operative]] who infiltrated Dooku's mercenary group as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo" />
